sources.1: City Transport Annual Report 2025, p. 12: Bike-share trips rose to 4.1 million in 2025, up from 3.4 million in 2024. E-bikes made up 38% of trips. Average trip length was 14 minutes.
sources.2: Council minutes, 3 February 2026: The council approved 120 new docking stations, to be installed in the eastern districts by the end of 2026. Funding comes from the regional mobility fund.
sources.3: Rider survey, November 2025 (n = 2,300): 61% of riders said they use the service to commute. The most requested improvement was more stations near train stations (44%).

claims.text: Bike-share trips grew to 4.1 million in 2025.
The council approved 120 new docking stations for the eastern districts.
The new stations will be paid for by a fare increase.
Most riders use bike share to get to work.
Riders are happier with the service than they were a year ago.
Bike-share trips fell in 2025 compared with 2024.
